faultMethod: Disposable private SQLite files only. A temporary trigger first raises a named ABORT to prove the selected statement is reached, then attempts a bounded allocation below 2 MiB under max_page_count. This generates a real SQLite FULL result without filling the host disk. Busy tests lower their own connection timeout to 1ms; ordinary 5-second timeout remains unchanged.
